name: Easy Sheet Pan Broccoli-Beef with Ramen Noodles

ingredients.name: instant ramen noodle soup, beef flavor

instructions.primary_message: Open ramen packages and remove seasoning packets. Place seasoning in a large bowl along with water, sugar, oil, minced garlic, ginger paste, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce. (Reserve noodles for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (85 g) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, beef flavor
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tsp minced garlic
1 tsp ginger paste
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the sauce, along with broccoli, and stir to combine. Transfer beef and broccoli to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until broccoli is starting to soften, about 10 minutes.
Remove baking sheet from the oven, stir, and spread back out in an even layer. Return to the oven and continue to roast until beef is cooked through and broccoli is fork-tender, 8-10 minutes more.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, add reserved noodles and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 3-4 minutes. Drain in a colander.
To serve, divide noodles between plates or bowls, then top with beef, broccoli, and any sauce from the baking sheet. Enjoy!
